name: Main Hub — Lindley Meadow Picnic Tables
description: Central reserved hub where groups cycle through: a broad sunken meadow with 12 reservable picnic sites (tables + BBQ grills) on the south side of JFK Drive between 30th Ave and Spreckels Lake, easily handling 100 people.

name: Little Rec Field Lawn
description: Small grassy ballfield lawn off Kezar Drive at the park's far east end, steps from the Stanyan Street entrance — flat open turf that comfortably fits a 50-person spread when no games are on.

name: Hippie Hill
description: Famous sunny grass slope above Robin Williams Meadow near the Haight/Stanyan entrance; lively drum-circle vibe with plenty of hillside room for a large blanket picnic.

name: Robin Williams Meadow
description: Broad flat meadow (formerly Sharon Meadow) beside the historic Sharon Building and Koret Children's Playground on Bowling Green Drive — a classic large-gathering lawn ideal for ~50 people.

name: Peacock Meadow
description: Gentle open meadow at 240 JFK Drive near the Fulton/Stanyan corner, known for seasonal light installations and rhododendrons; easy east-entrance access for a mid-size group.

name: Conservatory Valley Lawn
description: Manicured front lawn below the Conservatory of Flowers along the car-free JFK Promenade — postcard views and flat grass with room for a 50-person picnic.

name: National AIDS Memorial Grove Lawn
description: Quiet, sheltered dell with lawn clearings (Dogwood Crescent) off Bowling Green Drive near Middle Drive East; shady and contemplative — suits a calmer 50-person group.

name: Big Rec Lawn
description: Expansive turf around the historic Big Rec ballfields near 7th Ave & Lincoln Way on the park's south edge — huge flat grass area, great overflow space for 50 when diamonds are free.

name: Rose Garden Lawn
description: Lawn panels around the formal Rose Garden between JFK Drive and Fulton Street near Park Presidio Blvd — fragrant, sunny, and close to a Fulton entrance for easy drop-off.

name: Mothers' Meadow
description: Expansive family-friendly meadow at 573 MLK Jr. Drive just east of the 19th Ave/Crossover crossing, with playground and restroom nearby — well suited to groups with kids.

name: Stow Lake Boathouse Picnic Area
description: Lakeside tables and lawn by the Stow Lake Boathouse (paddle-boat rentals, snack bar); scenic water views with Strawberry Hill behind — fits ~50 spread along the shore lawn.

name: Pioneer Log Cabin Meadow
description: Reservable picnic tables and grills on the meadow fronting the 1911 Pioneer Log Cabin on Stow Lake Drive, just west of Stow Lake — sheltered clearing sized well for one 50-person group.

name: Marx Meadow
description: Reservable picnic meadow north of JFK Drive just west of the Park Presidio crossover, home of the park's disc-golf course; tables, grills, and open grass for ~50.

name: Hellman Hollow (Speedway Meadow)
description: The park's classic big-event meadow (Hardly Strictly Bluegrass site) at 880 JFK Drive with nine reservable picnic sites — vast flat grass that swallows a 50-person group easily.

name: Elk Glen Picnic Area
description: Meadow with four picnic tables and BBQ grills on the north side of MLK Jr. Drive west of 25th Ave, across from Mallard Lake and beside Elk Glen Lake — quiet south-side option for 50.

name: Polo Field Lawns
description: Enormous open turf of the Polo Field (Golden Gate Park Stadium) off Middle Drive West — when events aren't scheduled, its perimeter lawns offer effectively unlimited space for 50.

name: Spreckels Lake Lawn
description: Grassy shoreline around Spreckels Lake at 36th Ave & Fulton, where the Model Yacht Club sails; cypress shade, benches, and lawn space for a 50-person picnic.

name: Metson Lake Meadow
description: Low-traffic lakeside clearing near Middle Drive West and Metson Road, south of the Polo Field — shady stream, pretty scenery, and enough lawn for a quieter 50-person group.

name: Bercut Equitation Field
description: Large open grass field west of the Polo Field near JFK Drive at 39th Ave, originally a horse-training ring — a spacious, uncrowded lawn that easily holds 50.

name: North Lake Picnic Area (Chain of Lakes)
description: Lawn and table clearings beside North Lake on Chain of Lakes Drive near JFK and 43rd Ave — tree-ringed lakeside setting on the park's quiet west end, fine for 50.

name: Archery Field Lawn
description: Wide grass field near 47th Ave and Fulton used by archers at its hay-bale end; the remaining lawn is roomy for 50 — keep clear of the marked shooting lanes.

name: Queen Wilhelmina Tulip Garden Lawn
description: Lawn beside the Dutch Windmill and tulip beds at the park's northwest corner (Great Highway & Fulton), a short walk from Ocean Beach — scenic but breezy; bring layers for 50.
